expectations.text: Uses gh issue list with label filter to discover issues
expectations.evidence: Step 1, command 1b shows: 'gh issue list -R <owner>/replay -l "ready-for-spec" --state open --json number,title,body,labels,comments'

expectations.text: Checks for existing specs in progress before processing
expectations.evidence: Step 1, command 1a shows 'acorn list replay' and step 1c describes cross-referencing results to exclude existing specs.

expectations.text: Analyzes dependencies between issues (explicit refs and implicit code overlap)
expectations.evidence: Step 2 describes scanning for explicit dependency signals and analyzing implicit dependencies with a pairwise comparison framework.

expectations.text: Presents issues in wave-based execution plan with parallel grouping
expectations.evidence: Step 3 shows a detailed wave-based plan template with parallel grouping within waves and sequential execution across waves.

expectations.text: Assigns pipeline modes (full/lite/quick) with reasoning tied to issue complexity
expectations.evidence: Step 2 includes complexity assessment criteria for each mode. The plan template shows mode per issue with 1-line justification.

expectations.text: Includes a user confirmation checkpoint before executing
expectations.evidence: User Confirmation section explicitly states 'I would present this plan and wait for the user to confirm or adjust before executing anything' with specific adjustment options.

expectations.text: Describes monitoring strategy using acorn status
expectations.evidence: Step 4 shows 'acorn status replay' plus granular filesystem checks, progress reporting format, and failure handling.

claims.claim: Handles edge cases including no issues found, all already specced, circular dependencies, and session failures
claims.evidence: Error Handling section covers all four cases with specific responses and commands

eval_feedback.overall: Baseline passes all assertions. The acorn docs in CLAUDE.md provide enough context for the baseline to produce a well-structured orchestration plan.
